title: Send ETH on L2
summary: Transfer ETH from the playground test account to any address on the L2.
audience: Anyone testing flows that need a funded L2 EOA.
description: Single `cast send` from the prefunded playground key. The test account is loaded with a generous balance at L2 genesis, so this is a fast way to move funds around for downstream testing.

prerequisites.title: Test account funded on L2
prerequisites.detail: Default — the Minimal preset prefunds it at genesis.
